steps.intakeDesc: Create the Case, raw submission and immutable ingestion receipt.
steps.classifyDesc: Identify discipline, risk, country and lifecycle stage.

CaseCreate.boundary: Creating a case does not change schedule, contract, model or equipment state. High-risk external actions still require human approval.

Integrations.title: Enterprise integration control plane
Integrations.subtitle: Schedule, engineering, documents, commercial, geospatial and telemetry sources map into native domain objects; only actionable changes emit events.
Integrations.secretPolicy: Credentials are read from deployment secrets and are never stored in connector configuration.

DataIngestion.title: Six entry channels. One traceable data foundation.
DataIngestion.subtitle: Work orders, documents, master data, enterprise systems, BIM/GIS and IoT enter by domain with common validation, receipts and lineage. Data is not an event; only actionable change emits one.
DataIngestion.principleDetail: Native domain meaning · governed identity and version · fully auditable ingestion
DataIngestion.missingReceipt: The API returned data without a standard ingestion receipt.
DataIngestion.ocrPending: The original file is preserved. OCR must finish before AI classification and Case creation.
DataIngestion.unknownError: Ingestion failed. Check the input and try again.
DataIngestion.receiptEmptyHint: Submit the form to see the target object, validation result, mapping version and source lineage.

fields.contentHint: Country, project, discipline and risk are identified before an actionable case is created.
fields.documentHint: PDF, DOCX and TXT are supported. Scanned files are preserved and queued as OCR required; text-bearing files enter analysis.
fields.secretHint: Only the alias is stored; credentials come from deployment secrets.
fields.uriHint: Supports https://, s3://, ifc://, tiles://, geojson:// and mqtt://.
fields.sensorHint: Use SNS-VIB-AHU01 with the demo project.

Assistant.greeting: Hi, what should I handle today?
Assistant.intro: Describe a site issue, upload an owner letter, or just ask. I assemble specialist agents, cite evidence, and route anything that needs a decision to you for approval.
Assistant.placeholder: Describe a site issue, paste an owner letter, or ask a question… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
Assistant.placeholderIncident: What happened: project, location, issue, owner requirement and deadline…
Assistant.placeholderKnowledge: Which regulation or requirement? e.g. working-at-height requirements in Malaysia
Assistant.restrictedHint: Mark as sensitive: forces the local model, nothing is sent to the cloud

intents.incident: Detected: incident report · work order created

Assistant.boundary: AI only proposes and drafts. External actions require human approval and independent verification before closure.
Assistant.thinkingIncident: Creating the work order, assembling specialists and retrieving evidence…
Assistant.help: I can: (1) turn a site issue or owner letter (PDF/Word/TXT) into a work order with evidence-backed recommendations; (2) search local regulations and the knowledge base; (3) report project progress; (4) list pending approvals. Add detail such as project, location, issue and deadline.
Assistant.caseIntro: Work order {id} created and classified as "{type}", risk: {risk}. Here are the specialist findings and the response plan.
Assistant.noEvidence: No sufficiently relevant evidence in the knowledge base.
Assistant.governanceHint: A reply draft is generated only after every approval; the work order closes only after independent verification.
Assistant.rejectedHint: Rejected: rework is required before resubmission.
Assistant.draftBoundary: Drafts are generated inside the platform only; no email or external letter is sent.
Assistant.knowledgeFound: Found {count} relevant sources in the knowledge base:
Assistant.knowledgeNone: No sufficiently relevant evidence for "{query}" in the knowledge base. I will not invent an answer; try rephrasing, or report it as an incident for the specialists.
Assistant.knowledgeBoundary: Deterministic TF-IDF retrieval; specific legal obligations must be confirmed by the authority or legal team.
Assistant.confirmHint: The project could not be determined from the content, and the system will not guess. Pick a project and the specialists will re-run the analysis and create the approval items.

statuses.APPROVED: approved, ready to generate the reply draft
statuses.EXECUTION_FAILED: draft generation failed, can be retried
